endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.tripleCone_fiber_coefficient_bound
endpoints.expanded_type:

      ∀ (R : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin r) → ℝ),
        Continuous R →
          (∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin r)), 1 ≤ R x) →
            (∀ (x d : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin r)), R (x + d) ≤ R x + ‖d‖) →
              ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin r)) (Z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)),
                ‖Z‖ ≤ R x →
                  |inner Z
                          (2 •
                            ∫ (ω : ↑(Metric.sphere 0 1)) in RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHSphericalSection C,
                              ↑ω ∂MeasureTheory.volume.toSphere)| *
                      RectangleCLTArxivV1.tripleEuclideanDensity Z ≤
                    6144 * Real.exp (3 / 2) *
                      ∫ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) in (C ∩ Metric.ball 0 (1 / (4 * R x))) \ {0},
                        R (x + L y) ^ 4 * RectangleCLTArxivV1.tripleEuclideanDensity (Z + y)

  MeasurableSet C →
    (∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < t → ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), t • y ∈ C ↔ y ∈ C) →
      ∀ (R : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) → ℝ),
        Continuous R →
          (∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))), 1 ≤ R x) →
            (∀ (x d : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))), R (x + d) ≤ R x + ‖d‖) →
              ∀ (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector (n + 1)) (b : RectangleCLT.Vector m) (s : Finset (Fin m)),
                (∀ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector (n + 1)),
                    ‖Z‖ ≤
                      R (RectangleCLT.projectionEuclideanVector (RectangleCLTArxivV1.tripleTransportSection L Z g))) →
                  MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun g => R (RectangleCLT.projectionEuclideanVector g) ^ 4)
                      (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian (n + 1)) →
                    |inner Z
                              (2 •
                                ∫ (ω : ↑(Metric.sphere 0 1)) in RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHSphericalSection C,
                                  ↑ω ∂MeasureTheory.volume.toSphere)| *
                          RectangleCLTArxivV1.tripleEuclideanDensity Z *
                        (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian (n + 1)).real

                            ∀ k ∈ s,
                              RectangleCLT.faceDot (u k) (RectangleCLTArxivV1.tripleTransportSection L Z g) < b k} ≤
                      6144 * Real.exp (3 / 2) *
                        ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector (n + 1)),
                          (RectangleCLTArxivV1.tripleConeEvent L Z R u b s C).indicator
